bind_address.description: IP address the daemon listens on (e.g., 127.0.0.1, 0.0.0.0)

max_connections.description: Maximum number of simultaneous client connections

log_file.description: Path to log file; empty string means log to stderr

response_prefix.description: Static text prepended to all finger responses (e.g., for organizational disclaimer)

enable_user_enumeration.description: Allow listing all system users via finger (security-sensitive: disable in production)

backend_module.description: Backend module to use for user data (unix or ldap)

backend_passwd_file.description: Path to passwd file (used by unix backend)

backend_group_file.description: Path to group file (used by unix backend)

backend_shell_file.description: Path to shells file (used by unix backend)

ldap_uri.description: LDAP server URI (used by ldap backend)

ldap_base_dn.description: Base DN for LDAP searches (used by ldap backend)

ldap_bind_dn.description: Bind DN for authenticated LDAP access (leave blank for anonymous)

ldap_bind_password.description: Password for LDAP bind (use secrets management in production)

ldap_user_filter.description: LDAP filter for user lookup; '{{ query_user }}' is replaced with the requested username

custom_handlers.description: List of custom command-based response handlers

command.description: Shell command to execute for this handler

name.description: Descriptive label for this limit rule

max_per_minute.description: Maximum finger requests allowed per minute

tls_key_file.description: Path to TLS private key (PEM format)
